findings.finding: Build verification mixes host and container path namespaces and rejects actual project compiler dependencies.
Writable requested mounts may omit ReadOnly=false, but the checker requires an explicit false field.
Command argv and complete stream-loss evidence plus a positive complete-record test remain incomplete.

independent_review.nonblocking_limitation: A parent death between stopped-container create and CID-bound watchdog readiness can leave a stopped container, but cannot start the build; preserve and audit before broader reuse.
